name: The Horde Needs Firebloom!
label: Quest
description: The Horde Needs Firebloom!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hey, adventurer. Ya you, mon! There be a whole mess of firebloom the Horde thinkin' they need for this Ahn'Qiraj war effort. Maybe they put it in nice things that go boom? Maybe they give it to the Alliance as fuel for their steam tanks? Who knows? Not Pele'keiki!
Pele'keiki know this though... He know you gonna help him out and bring back lots of the firebloom, right, mon?

clips.title: Progress
paras: You not want to make Pele'keiki mad. You make Pele'keiki happy by bringing him lots of firebloom, real soon.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Adventurer! Pele'keiki happy for now. Pele'keiki take all that firebloom and put it in box so it stay fresh. Pele'keiki be seein' to it that all the firebloom bein' made into good stuff for the war. And if you be gettin' anymore, you come see Pele'keiki fast. Pele'keiki prolly be needin' more.
